title: Tokimeki Mahjong Graffiti: Toshishita no Tenshitachi
native_title: ときめき麻雀グラフィティ ～年下の天使たち～
overview:
Play a mahjong game with us

We may not look it, but we're pretty strong. But if we lose...

A lavish lineup of voice actresses too!

Tokimeki Mahjong Graffiti: Toshishita no Tenshitachi is an adult mahjong game for one player. You sit down at the table against three girls, Megumi Kisaragi, Ran Aizuki and Kasumi Mutsuki, and play one-on-one hands of mahjong. Beat them and they reward you with animated scenes and poses that get a little risque.

- Mahjong against three fully voiced opponents
- Animated character scenes between hands
- Rated X (18 and over)

私たちと麻雀ゲームで遊ぼっ♥

こう見えても私たち、けっこう強いのヨ。でも負けたら…。

声優陣も豪華ラインナップ！
